crime: During afternoon free time, {WITCH_NAME} sometimes took phone pictures in the courtyard with her only close friend. The friend enjoyed it and trusted her with the camera. {WITCH_NAME} often asked if they were still all right, and the friend always said yes. One afternoon, the friend handed her a phone and asked her to photograph the friend with several other girls beside the fountain. They posed together, then left without offering to take another picture that included her.

Later, {WITCH_NAME} used True Answer to ask whether the group had meant to leave her out. The friend had to give the answer she believed: no one had discussed excluding her. The girls had simply wanted a picture of themselves and had never thought of her as part of their group.

{WITCH_NAME} invited the friend back to the fountain during the next morning's free time for a picture of the two of them. The friend agreed because she intended to tell her to stop forcing answers. Frightened by the earlier compulsion, the friend secretly started a phone recording before entering the courtyard and kept the phone with her.

Later that morning, prisoners found the friend bent over the fountain rim with her face in the water. She had drowned. The water was shallow, her head was uninjured, and her phone was still recording. At first, it appeared that she had fainted or slipped while preparing the photograph and had been unable to lift her head.

Prisoners who knew both voices listened to the uninterrupted recording. The friend first said that she wanted distance. A splash and repeated sounds of a struggle followed. {WITCH_NAME} kept asking whether they were still all right, and every question forced the friend to answer no through the water. The answers stopped, and {WITCH_NAME} left the courtyard; the recording captured her footsteps.

The body and recording showed that {WITCH_NAME} had held the friend's upper body over the fountain rim while repeatedly using True Answer. Each forced reply drew water into the friend's airway, and her physical hold prevented the friend from lifting her head. The friend drowned.
fields.epitaph: Her last question was sealed inside the bell, where no answer could reach it.
execution: A massive iron bell hangs above her as she is restrained upright beneath it. Its opening is wide enough to cover her head, while its thick lower rim meets her shoulders.

The bell descends without stopping. It covers her head and seals her voice inside, then strikes her shoulders and drives her body downward against the stand. The iron rim crushes her shoulders, chest, ribs, and spine. It stops with her collapsed corpse pinned beneath the rim and her head still sealed inside.

magic.name: True Answer
magic.text: She can force someone to answer a question with what that person believes is true.
